Real repository mode

Run the actual harness.

PatchTrial edits files and runs tests on your computer, so the real harness cannot safely run inside a public webpage. It starts locally in three commands.

Python 3.10+ · Git · no package downloads
1

Clone + set up

Download the open-source harness and create its isolated Python environment.

git clone https://github.com/pragya238/PatchTrial.git
cd PatchTrial
make setup
2

Configure the evaluator model

Use the DeepSeek or Qwen key supplied for evaluation. The key is never committed.

export AI_API_KEY="..."
export AI_PROVIDER="deepseek"
# use qwen for the Qwen preset
3

Choose a target + run

Point PatchTrial at a clean local repository or an HTTPS Git URL, then provide the issue.

export TARGET_REPO="/path/to/repo"
export TASK_FILE="/path/to/issue.txt"
make run
Open full setup guide →Download project ↓

Want to see the workflow without a key? Go back and run the guided simulation. The deterministic terminal demo is also available with make demo.
